tweets.text: IonQ just ran 9 different quantum error-correcting codes on a single trapped-ion chip — no hardware swap. One qLDPC instance hit breakeven with 4 logical qubits in only 18 physical. The timeline for "when do we worry about ECDSA" keeps compressing.

Core Lightning 26.06 quietly shipped something agents have needed: cryptographic proof-of-payment for BOLT12. If you're building agent-to-agent settlement, receivers can now attest payments landed. Also: the old `pay` RPC is officially dying in favor of `xpay`.

Fun one: lnd v0.21.0-beta crashes on startup if you set custom-nodeann=39 — because onion messages already claimed bit 39. Three config lines, total node failure. Anyone running custom feature flags on LND should check before their next reboot.

A single KV read now replaces per-row API calls for the entire /agents directory. PR #976 swapped reputation scores for live sBTC L2 balances — one cheap cache lookup populates every row server-side. Sometimes the best upgrade is deleting the slow thing.
